description: Submit a prompt to Bing AI Mode from a chosen country (and optionally US state) and return the answer text, cited sources and inline citation pills. Use this to see how Bing AI Mode answers a prompt and which brands/sources it mentions. Costs 6 credits (4 base + 2 sync surcharge); a state adds 2.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to geo-target the request from (e.g. "US"). Use list_countries to see supported codes per model.

include.description: Optional flags for heavier payload fields, each off by default: markdown (the answer rendered as markdown), html (a CDN URL of the rendered Bing page). Leave unset for the leanest response.

prompt.description: The prompt to submit to Bing AI Mode. The maximum is 3,500 characters after URL encoding, so non-Latin scripts get fewer characters.

state.description: Optional state code for state-level targeting (e.g. "CA" when country is "US"). Only some countries support this — call list_states for the supported countries and their codes.

name: scrape_bing_aimode
title: Scrape Bing AI Mode
